createdAt.description: The timestamp at which the standard financial statement was generated

requestedAt.description: The timestamp at which the standard financial statement was requested

status.description: Whether the standard financial statement is 'complete', 'pending' or 'failed'.

statusDetails.description: Additional information about the status of the standard financial statement (if applicable)

message.description: A message describing the status of the standard financial statement, e.g. an error if the standard financial statement status is 'failed'
